# WO-2026-08-11-B15-VISION-01 — Vision pipeline: deterministic prep, region-grounded reads, provenance

## Acceptance criteria

AC1: A deterministic image pre-processing stage exists (orientation correction, deskew, border trim, numbered overlapping strip generation) — pure/local, no model call, unit-tested independent of any live gateway.
AC2: The vision call sends the corrected page + numbered strips + household Regulars/Favourites/aliases context in ONE request per normal case; per-line output requires a `source_region` that must resolve against an application-supplied region persisted in `shop_image_region` — never a model-asserted coordinate.
AC3 (= acceptance_property): a PHOTO-provenance row with no valid `source_region` is rejected at the DATABASE level (Silas's CHECK + composite FK), not merely by application code — proven by an executed test that attempts the invalid insert and asserts the database refuses it.
AC4: Deterministic, LLM-free sanity checks reject/flag implausible quantities, unmatched lines, and missing `source_region`; cross-strip duplicates are resolved via `shop_line_provenance.superseded_by_id` (or an explicitly justified equivalent) — not left as a TODO comment.
AC5: The batched follow-up vision call (at most one, covering every flagged region in a single request) triggers on EITHER low model confidence OR a deterministic anomaly from AC4 — proven by two separate tests, one exercising each trigger path independently, confirming neither alone is sufficient by design and either alone is sufficient in practice.
AC6: `shop_line_provenance` rows persist with provenance exactly one of `PHOTO`/`REGULARS`/`RULE`/`WARWICK` BEFORE Regulars/rules enrichment runs against them — the two stages remain genuinely separate, provable by reading the call order in the implementation.
AC7: `shop.human_state` is set to exactly one of `NEEDS_WARWICK`/`ASDAIR_WORKING`/`READY_FOR_WARWICK`/`BROWSER_WORKING`/`COMPLETE`/`FAILED`, computed in exactly one place in this pipeline layer — not duplicated elsewhere. State this exact column/table name plainly in your final report; the parallel Cockpit-backend WP built against a placeholder name and needs this to reconcile.
AC8: An A/B acceptance test harness (bundled single call vs. individually-called follow-up strips) is built as a runnable script against the one photograph this build has a verified-correct answer for (`Deliverables/2026-08-11-trolley-reconciliation-41-lines.md`) — callable, NOT executed by you (no gateway credentials; that run is Asdair's, later).
AC9: All touched-package tests pass with a non-zero executed count reported.

## Required evidence

- The exact test-runner invocation and its reported pass count (non-zero) for every touched package.
- The exact failing-insert test output for AC3 (the acceptance_property) — paste the actual database error, not a paraphrase.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/asdair/pipeline services/obsidiwikai/src/core/models.mjs services/asdair/db` → report exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass.
